title: BAY REFEREE production delivery manifest
description: Metadata contract only. Validation does not prove file existence, hash correctness, decode success, timing, visual quality or approval. Runtime QA must verify each generated record against disk. The manifest does not hash itself.

audio_packages.description: EN/ES are native narration-only packages by default, not guaranteed to match the Turkish picture duration. Any picture-aligned derivative must be separately labelled and aligned from its actual final audio.

caption_timing.description: Each SRT follows timestamps from the exact audio listed in its own authority, not Turkish video timing borrowed by another language. A picture-aligned derivative requires a nonempty label plus its own Whisper and word-map paths.
